## Objective and scope

Synthesize trajectory and comparator evidence into a ranked causal explanation and the smallest justified optimization experiment.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Separate derivative/implementation error, reweighting/support effects, optimizer limitations, regularization tradeoffs, scale/interpolation issues and anatomical ambiguity of the data term.
2. Compare current and reference anatomy/deformation patterns on the same cases. Any representation-capacity probe must declare its diagnostic nature and preserve map-direction/geometry checks.
3. Predeclare O01/O02 baseline equations, physical units, experiment lanes and search budget; give each lane a hypothesis and stop/expand rule.
4. Keep broad rewrites, extra iterations and new metrics conditional on this evidence; an unresolved diagnosis is reported as such, with the experiment designed to discriminate it.

## Planned areas

- docs/benchmarks/
- optimizer experiment protocols

## Blocking prerequisites

- D02 (`bd-01M4X4DYCNRG58VQVKJKH77WWR`)
- P02 (`bd-01M4X4DXW7WGW5WK0J3Z6PFP98`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.
